title: Continuous functions are bounded and integrable on the open unit cube
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, let Euclid k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) carry Lebesgue measure (volume), and let Q₁ := {y : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i}. If f : Euclid k → ℝ is continuous, then (a) there is M ∈ ℝ with |f(y)| ≤ M for every y ∈ Q₁, and (b) f is integrable on Q₁.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Euclid k → ℝ), Continuous f → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |f y| ≤ M) ∧ IntegrableOn f {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}
